images.alt: Dashboard view showing total disk usage broken down by category, with a bento grid of reclaimable space across Junk, Large Files, Developer artifacts, and Duplicates.
Developer Tools view listing detected toolchain caches: Xcode DerivedData, npm/Yarn/pnpm, Docker images, pip and Poetry, JetBrains IDEs, Gradle and Maven, with size and safety rating per row.
Confidence rating system. Files are classified as Safe (auto-rebuilds, e.g. caches and DerivedData), Review (logs, installers, Docker images), or Caution (personal files, never auto-selected).
Before and after comparison on a 500 GB drive. Disk usage goes from 127 GB used (85% full warning) to 75 GB used after removing dev caches, duplicates, orphaned app data, and system junk.

WHAT IS DEEPCLEAN?

DeepClean is a native macOS disk cleanup utility that goes beyond surface-level cache clearing. It scans the entire disk and surfaces what is actually consuming space, then lets the user review every item before anything is deleted.




Categories of clutter DeepClean detects:



System and application caches in ~/Library/Caches and ~/Library/Logs
Temporary files in /tmp and /var/folders
Browser caches across Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Arc, and Opera
Duplicate files detected by content hash, with side-by-side preview
Large files sorted by size, age, and last-accessed date with QuickLook preview
Leftover data from uninstalled apps (orphaned support files, preferences, launch agents)
Developer artifacts: Xcode derived data, simulators, archives, node_modules, Python virtual environments, Docker images and volumes, Homebrew, Gradle and Maven caches, JetBrains and VS Code caches, HuggingFace and PyTorch model caches
iOS device backups in MobileSync
Installer files (.dmg, .pkg, .iso, .xip) sitting in Downloads
Broken symlinks and empty folders



Safety features:



Every item has a confidence rating (Safe, Review, Caution) based on UTI and path classification
Files move to the Trash, not permanent deletion, so anything can be restored
Pre-deletion verification confirms each file still exists and matches before removing it
Exclusion lists let users protect specific files, folders, or apps



Other features:



Per-app storage breakdown including caches and support files
Scan cache so the app shows results instantly on relaunch instead of re-scanning
Menu bar widget with current disk status
Dark mode and light mode



Privacy:



All processing happens on the Mac. No data is uploaded.
No analytics, no telemetry, no account required.



Distribution:



Direct download from the developer
Not available on the Mac App Store because Full Disk Access is required to scan ~/Library.



Pricing is a one-time purchase, no subscription.
